title: Universal Pull
body:
Syntax: perform universal pull <target>

Description: Draw a target off balance with Rinnegan gravity, dealing chakra damage and disrupting its footing. This implementation affects one target already in your room. Base damage: 1509-1789. 75% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 75 only for Indra reincarnations of any combat class. Requires your Six Paths mode active. Train and use the technique to increase its mastery. Costs 75 Chakra and 10 Stamina; 16 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
